name: Sourcetree
author: Atlassian Pty Ltd
summary: Sourcetree simplifies how you interact with your Git repositories so you can focus on coding. Visualize and manage your repositories through Sourcetree's simple Git GUI.

versions.release_notes:
- Fixed: Push and Pull operations ignoring branch tracking remote
- Fixed: Selected commit position lost or jumping after fetch operation
- Fixed: Vulnerability allowing Remote Code Execution via Mercurial repository trust check bypass
- Fixed: Vulnerability allowing Remote Code Execution via untrusted diff configuration in .git/config
- Fixed: Vulnerability causing coerced NTLM authentication via sourcetree:// URI handler
- Fixed: Vulnerability causing command execution via Git-flow release and hotfix branch names
- Fixed: Vulnerability with incomplete Git configuration checks in repository trust prompt
- Fixed: kdiff3 location resetting to legacy executable path

- Changes: Added support for rotating OAuth refresh tokens and handling of oversized tokens stored in Windows Credential Manager
- Fixed: Allow disabling AutoStartSSHAgent when using OpenSSH to support external ssh-agent
- Fixed: Branch filter preference not saved and resets to "All Branches" on restart
- Fixed: Checkout fails to discard pending submodule changes
- Fixed: Custom action parameter $BRANCH not always properly replaced
- Fixed: Jump to Commit not working on first attempt in large repositories
- Fixed: Opening two repositories with the same folder name simultaneously not supported
- Fixed: Renaming repository from New Tab screen fails when repository list is filtered
- Fixed: Search/View in Full Log no longer working

- Changes: Added support for force fetching tags from the Fetch and Pull dialog
- Changes: GitLab integration to support viewing repositories by group
- Fixed: Branch colors in the history graph changed after interactions
- Fixed: GitLab repositories not appearing or being searchable in the Remote Repositories view

- Fixed: Commit history not refreshing
- Fixed: ShowRemoteBranch and AllBranches views not working

- Changes: Breaking Changes : Replace Deprecated BBC Cross-Workspace API's
- Fixed: About box link to official PuTTY website
- Fixed: File selection behavior in preview and conflict resolution
- Fixed: Grammar in invalid clone path error message
- Fixed: Sourcetree gets stuck loading some commits

- Fixed: SourceTree Windows EXE Signing Expiration
- Fixed: SourceTree doesn't deselect files that are off-screen
- Fixed: Tags appear in Git log even when "Show tag labels" option is unchecked

- Changes: Added Shortcut Support for Custom Actions
- Changes: Enhanced Log/History with Selectable Branch Filtering
- Fixed: Affecting Interactive Rebasing of Child Commits
- Fixed: Double-Click Diff Action Restored
- Fixed: Enhanced SourceTree UI for managing autocrlf Values
- Fixed: Mislabeled Tooltip for “Trust Exit Code”
- Fixed: Tree View Sort Order Reset in File Status
- Fixed: Updated Bundled 7-Zip to Address Vulnerabilities
- Fixed: “Intent to Add” files disappearing from File Status View

- Fixed: Double-click option incorrectly affected "Open File" in context menu
- Fixed: Embedded Git functionality stability

- Changes: Missing Italian translation
- Changes: Upgrade to Git 2.51.0 and Git LFS to 3.7.0
- Fixed: Incompatibility with roaming profiles
- Fixed: Mercurial.zip repeatedly downloaded and extracted on launch when spellcheck is enabled
- Fixed: Validation error when saving edited custom actions

- Changes: Added support for stashing only selected or staged files
- Changes: Addressed high CPU usage by SSH-Agent.exe
- Changes: Allow using Esc as a hotkey for closing message dialogs
- Changes: Introduced support for API Token-based authentication
- Fixed: Commit history time display to 24-Hour format for better clarity
- Fixed: Commit section doesn't update username after refresh
- Fixed: Delay when closing settings window
- Fixed: Interactive rebase failing on Cyrillic repository paths
- Fixed: Italian language support with updated translations
- Fixed: Japanese language support with updated translations
- Fixed: Remote repositories filter not working correctly
- Fixed: Repositories appearing multiple times after account switch
- Fixed: Vulnerability Causing NTLM Hash Exposure During Clone
